outputs.explanation: Panel A shows bright-field and ICG fluorescence photographs of whole lungs; it is a photograph, not a plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.
Bar graph of mean ICG fluorescence intensity with SD error bars already overlays the individual biological-replicate data points (blue dots for No Cre, red dots for Adeno Cre).
Panel C combines micrographs (H&E, ICG, RNAscope) with spatial heatmap plots of Cd68/Spp1 expression across tissue spots. Heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Bar graph shows log2 fold-change values for genes derived from differential expression analysis (Seurat FindMarkers/Wilcoxon test) comparing large populations of spatial transcriptomics spots between conditions. Each bar is a single computed statistic (not a mean of a small number of biological replicates), so overlaying discrete individual data points is not applicable/meaningful in this format.
Panel F shows ICG fluorescence and IHC photomicrographs, not a plot of averaged/aggregated data, so individual data points are not applicable.
